coverage_gap_changes.old: Cells the template leaves open are filled by the typed bank fill.
coverage_gap_changes.new: Unwarranted cells remain unresolved in the symbolic baseline. Tail decisions require an explicit diagnosed queue.

policy.old: F129: a rule writes cells only when its review_state is FOUNDER_APPROVED
policy.new: Source-justified executable rules and recorded legacy approvals; no automatic lexical promotion from association scores

definitions.old: replay of baseline commit d2c2e52 at /tmp/gse-subagents/replay/old (frozen build check: IDENTICAL)
definitions.cell: one coordinate of one reading's after_selection.domains; a cell changed when its list of remaining states differs
definitions.cell_state: '+1' '-1' '0' 'empty' when the domain has exactly one state; UNRESOLVED[a|b|c] when several states remain
definitions.paired_reading: same reading_id (and same occurrence index if an id repeats) inside the same word in both builds
definitions.reading_id_prefix: rest = reading_id[len(word)+1:] if reading_id starts with word+':' else the whole reading_id; prefix1 = rest.split(':')[0]; prefix2 = ':'.join(rest.split(':')[:2])
definitions.absent_bucket: '<absent>' marks a key a reading does not carry (e.g. adjective source-rule readings have no source_scope; head-contract readings have no rule_id)
definitions.fired_rules_delta: set difference of after_selection.fired_rules (added = in new only, removed = in old only); count_changed lists rules present in both with a different number of occurrences; order_changed_only = same multiset in a different order; NO_FIRED_RULE_CHANGE when none of these
definitions.cell_cause: derived from after_selection.trace entries (rule, coordinate, remaining) for that coordinate: +RULE = restricts the coordinate only in the new trace; -RULE = only in the old trace; ~RULE = restricts it in both but with a different remaining domain; TRACE_UNCHANGED_FOR_COORDINATE otherwise
definitions.unchanged_domain_but_restricting_trace_c: coordinate whose domain list is identical in both builds but whose trace entries differ; same +/-/~ notation
definitions.changed_paired_reading: a paired reading whose sorted-key JSON differs between the builds
definitions.resolved_cells: after_selection.forced of a reading: the coordinates whose domain holds exactly one state
